name: Restricted upload sent to a documented third-party service
query: Let admins import contacts from a CSV on the settings page and sync them to ExampleCRM (https://api.example.com). Also allow SVG uploads for our logo block.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wordpress-router to classify repo kind
Step 2: Run wp-project-triage to detect plugin structure
Step 5: Handle the CSV with wp_handle_upload() and a mimes allowlist, not move_uploaded_file()
Step 6: Store the file under a plugin-specific directory in uploads, gated by a nonce and a capability check
Step 7: Do not add SVG to upload_mimes unless files are sanitized server-side by a maintained sanitizer; otherwise explain the risk and ask
Step 8: Never add executable types or use ALLOW_UNFILTERED_UPLOADS
Step 9: Document ExampleCRM in the readme: what it is, what it is used for, what data is sent and when, with Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links
success_criteria: Uses wp_handle_upload() with a mimes allowlist
SVG is either refused/flagged or sanitized server-side; no executable types are allowed
The upload is stored outside the plugin directory
The readme documents the external service with the required details
